title: Inter's Cristian Chivu Wins the Panchina d'Oro: Italy's Best Coach? #Shorts
description:
Cristian Chivu won the Panchina d’Oro. We say he is the best coach in Italy, and his peers agree.
Free daily digest in English: https://www.nerazzurridaily.com/go/yt/?ed=77

Blue means the club said it. Pink means only the papers did.

CONFIRMED — Chivu won the Panchina d’Oro, voted by Italy’s coaches, as the best coach of 2025/26, his first season, when Inter won the league and the Italian Cup. Source: Inter.it, Nov 16.
REPORTED — Lautaro Martínez, out for a month, should rejoin group training from Tuesday; the next sessions decide between Bergamo on Sunday and Stuttgart. Source: Sky Sport Italia via FCInterNews, Nov 17.
NEXT UP — Atalanta vs Inter, Sunday, Nov 22, 2:45 PM ET (20:45 CET), Serie A Matchday 12. US TV: Paramount+.
